description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between, H. W. Sirinimal Vs. Amico Exports Limited and two other notices
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, specifically orders made under Section 4(1) of the Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains statutory instruments and legal procedures for dispute resolution, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions a government minister (Ravindra Samaraweera), it does not focus on government structure, personnel changes, or detailed portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the exercise of statutory powers under existing legislation.
